head_commit.message:
fix(tui): note Windows Terminal <1.24 flicker

Windows Terminal versions earlier than 1.24 don't support Synchronized Update (DEC Mode 2026), which can cause Codex output to flicker.

Show a non-error startup tip when we detect Windows Terminal <1.24 and recommend upgrading via the Microsoft Store.

Refs: https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/9081
Release: https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/releases/tag/v1.24.2372.0

head_commit.message:
Turn-state sticky routing per turn (#9332)

- capture the header from SSE/WS handshakes, store it per
ModelClientSession using `Oncelock`, echo it on turn-scoped requests,
and add SSE+WS integration tests for within-turn persistence +
cross-turn reset.

- keep `x-codex-turn-state` sticky within a user turn to maintain
routing continuity for retries/tool follow-ups.
